summary: The Interior Minister: the alert situation ends at midnight as planned; the government expects the country to return to normal on Thursday, with repair work; the government's crisis centre (CorGov, coordinated by the Prime Minister) meets after the Council of Ministers; "o período mais grave está aí à porta" (warning of heavy rain coinciding with high tide; the Algarve the main concern)
